data.one_liner: Query device for installed email apps and open them programmatically.
data.what_it_does: A Flutter plugin that queries the device for installed email apps and allows users to open a specific email app or view a picker list. It extends functionality beyond default url_launcher capabilities by letting users choose non-default mail applications.
use_when: You need to let users choose which specific email app to open on their device.
You need to query the list of installed email apps on Android or iOS.
avoid_when: You only need to open a generic mailto link with the default system mail app.
strengths: Supports identifying multiple installed email apps on Android and iOS.
Allows opening specific mail apps by name.
weaknesses: Requires manual configuration of LSApplicationQueriesSchemes in iOS Info.plist for app detection.
Breaking changes occurred between minor versions (e.g., removal of built-in picker dialog in v1.2.0).
data.setup_notes: For iOS, list the URL schemes of the email apps you want to query in your Info.plist file under LSApplicationQueriesSchemes. No additional setup is required for Android.
